title: Concept: Lockfile records git or path dependencies as version 0.0.0
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry whose version is the git/path placeholder `0.0.0`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The placeholder hides the real identity of the code, so version-based review and advisory matching cannot see what actually runs.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The placeholder hides the real identity of the code, so version-based review and advisory matching cannot see what actually runs.
